# AI Trail Tracker — Task Breakdown

> Derived from [spec.md](spec.md). Each task maps to one or more spec requirements.
> Tasks are ordered by dependency — earlier tasks unblock later ones.

---

## Task 1: Wire up frontend routing and navigation

The current `App.tsx` is a placeholder counter app. Replace it with the real router and navigation shell described in section 3.3 of the spec.

- [x] Install `react-router-dom` (if not already present)
- [x] Replace `App.tsx` with a layout shell containing a top nav bar (app title, user info, admin link when applicable)
- [x] Define routes: `/` → DashboardPage, `/admin` → AdminDashboardPage, `/admin/review/:userId` → ReviewSubmissionPage, `/admin/participant/:userId` → ParticipantDetailPage
- [x] Wrap admin routes with `ProtectedRoute` component (admin role check)
- [x] Add a "Not Found" fallback route
- [x] Verify navigation works end-to-end in the browser
- [ ] Write unit tests for route rendering and protected route redirect behavior

## Task 2: Add backend unit test project

No test infrastructure exists yet. Stand up the test project so subsequent tasks can add tests.

## Task 3: Add URL validation and input sanitization

Spec section 3.4 requires URL format validation and XSS sanitization on free-text fields.

### 3a — Backend URL validation
- [x] Add a URL format validation attribute or helper to validate evidence-link fields
- [x] Apply validation in `ParticipantController` evidence-save endpoint; return 400 with field-level error for malformed URLs
- [x] Accept `http://`, `https://` schemes only; reject `javascript:`, `data:`, and schemeless strings
- [x] Write backend unit tests for valid URLs (GitHub links, Webex recordings, training portal links)
- [x] Write backend unit tests for invalid URLs (missing scheme, script injection via URL, empty strings)

### 3b — Backend XSS sanitization on Notes fields
- [x] Add a sanitization utility that strips HTML tags and script content from free-text input
- [x] Apply sanitization in `ParticipantController` before persisting Notes fields
- [x] Write backend unit tests for plain-text passthrough (no modification)
- [x] Write backend unit tests for XSS payloads (`<script>`, `onerror=`, `<img src=x>`, encoded variants)

### 3c — Frontend client-side URL validation
- [x] Add URL format validation in `EvidenceInput` component (same rules as backend: require `http(s)://`)
- [x] Display inline error message below the input field when URL is invalid
- [x] Prevent save when any evidence URL is invalid (disable save button or show validation summary)
- [ ] Write frontend unit tests for valid/invalid URL input states and error message rendering

## Task 4: Add CSRF / anti-forgery protection

Spec section 3.4 item 6 requires anti-forgery tokens on all mutating operations.

- [x] Backend: Enable anti-forgery token middleware in `Program.cs` for non-GET endpoints
- [x] Frontend: Ensure the Axios client sends the anti-forgery token header on POST/PUT/DELETE requests
- [ ] Write an integration test confirming mutating requests without the token are rejected

---

## Task 5: Implement "Submit for Review" button logic and evidence locking

Spec section 3.1.3 (US-05): submit button enabled only when all criteria have evidence; submission locks evidence.

### 5a — Submit button validation and submission flow
- [x] Backend: In `ParticipantService`, validate all criteria have evidence before accepting a submission; return 400 otherwise
- [x] Backend: Verify the submit endpoint enforces that the authenticated user can only submit their own evidence (authorization check — spec §3.4 item 3)
- [x] Frontend: Enable the "Submit for Review" button only when every exit criterion has at least one evidence link
- [x] Frontend: Show a success toast / snackbar after submission confirming the level was submitted for review
- [x] Write backend unit tests for pre-submit validation (all criteria populated vs. missing evidence)
- [ ] Write a backend unit test proving a user cannot submit evidence for a different user (returns 403)
- [ ] Write frontend unit tests for button enabled/disabled state and confirmation toast

### 5b — Evidence locking after submission
- [x] Backend: Reject evidence updates when the level submission status is `Submitted` (return 409 Conflict)
- [x] Frontend: Disable `EvidenceInput` fields and save buttons when the submission is in `Submitted` or `Approved` state
- [x] Write backend unit tests confirming edits are rejected with 409 after submission
- [ ] Write frontend unit tests for disabled state of evidence inputs and save button

### 5c — Unlock rejected criteria for re-editing
- [x] Backend: Unlock only the specific rejected criteria when admin rejects (not the entire submission)
- [x] Frontend: Re-enable only rejected criteria for editing, per spec section 3.1.2 item 5
- [x] Write backend unit tests for selective unlock behavior (rejected criterion editable, approved criteria still locked)
- [ ] Write frontend unit tests for mixed state (some inputs disabled, rejected ones enabled)

---

## Task 6: Implement resubmission workflow for rejected criteria

Spec user story US-08: developer can update rejected evidence and resubmit.

- [x] Backend: Add endpoint or update existing endpoint to accept resubmission of individual rejected criteria
- [x] Backend: Reset criterion status from `Rejected` back to `EvidenceSubmitted` on resubmit
- [x] Frontend: Show admin feedback message on rejected criteria (from `SubmissionStatus` component)
- [x] Frontend: Allow editing and resubmitting only rejected criteria
- [x] Write backend unit tests for the resubmission flow
- [ ] Write frontend unit tests confirming the resubmit UX

- [x] Frontend: Display rejection feedback in `SubmissionStatus` on the developer dashboard
- [x] Write backend unit tests for rejection with and without feedback
- [ ] Write frontend unit tests for the rejection feedback dialog

## Task 8: Implement admin "Approve Level Advancement" action

- [x] Backend: Retain previous level evidence as historical record
- [x] Frontend: Show "Approve Level Advancement" button on `ReviewSubmissionPage`, enabled only when all criteria are approved
- [x] Frontend: Show confirmation dialog before advancing
- [x] Write backend unit tests for the advancement validation and state change
- [ ] Write frontend unit tests for the button enabled/disabled state and confirmation flow

### 12b — Pioneer activity log

- [ ] Backend: Add endpoint `GET /api/participant/activity-log` to retrieve activity log entries for the authenticated user

- [ ] Frontend: Display list of previously logged activities below the form

## Deferred / Out of Scope

The following spec items mention display elements whose underlying data sources (guilds) are out of scope per spec §5. They will be addressed when guild management is built.

- **Guild Info on developer dashboard** (§3.1.1) — no guild data model exists yet
- **Guild Overview on admin dashboard** (§3.2.1) — same dependency

## Dependency Order

```
Task 1  (routing)              — unblocks all frontend tasks
Task 2  (test project)         — unblocks all backend test subtasks
Task 3  (validation)           — depends on Task 2 for backend tests
Task 4  (CSRF)                 — depends on Task 2 for backend tests
Task 5  (submit + locking)     — depends on Tasks 1, 2
Task 6  (resubmission)         — depends on Tasks 5, 7
Task 7  (rejection feedback)   — depends on Task 2
Task 8  (level advancement)    — depends on Task 7
Task 9  (stats)                — depends on Tasks 1, 2
Task 10 (search/filter/sort)   — depends on Tasks 1, 2
Task 11 (participant detail)   — depends on Tasks 1, 10
Task 12 (Pioneer dashboard)    — depends on Tasks 1, 2
Task 13 (health endpoint)      — depends on Task 2
Task 14 (auth audit)           — depends on Task 2
Task 15 (backend tests)        — depends on Task 2; can run in parallel with feature tasks
Task 16 (frontend tests)       — depends on Task 1
Task 17 (smoke test)           — depends on all above
Task 18 (docs)                 — depends on Task 17
```
